acceptance_rule: Parse exactly one JSON object from the segment after the first configured end-of-think marker. If no marker is present and the provider reports finish_reason='stop' with no opened reasoning block, parse the whole message.
truncated_rule: Classify COMPLETED_OUTPUT_TRUNCATED when finish_reason='length', or when a start-of-think marker is present without its end marker.
grammar_gate: Do not use grammar-constrained decoding unless paired QA shows no material accuracy loss, enumeration-order collapse, or condition-specific distortion.
malformed_end_marker_note: Kimi-Dev-72B occasionally omits the closing marker glyph, emitting '◁/think'. The tolerant form is accepted so that a complete valid final answer is not discarded. The well-formed marker takes precedence wherever both match at the same position.
